text: opening grant and conditions 1-3, together with the final no-relicensing sentence (permissions are non-reciprocal; no same-license, source-disclosure, corresponding-source, linking, or network-use condition is stated)
text: opening grant (commercial and non-commercial use plus redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted; no field-of-use limitation is stated)

text: introductory Systemics/W3Works paragraphs require retaining the copyright and W3Works modification attribution; original paragraph requires source redistributions to retain the copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer and binary redistributions to reproduce them; both advertising clauses require a fixed Systemics or W3Works acknowledgement

text: conditions 1-2 activate notice retention/reproduction on source or binary redistribution; both advertising clauses separately activate named acknowledgements for advertising materials mentioning features or use, a trigger dimension without an exact vocabulary value (retained as unknown); modification alone has no separate changed-file trigger

text: final sentence prohibits changing the license and distribution terms or placing the code under another distribution license (an additional-term restriction); introductory and original disclaimer paragraphs disclaim express/implied warranties and limit liability; no separate endorsement/name or trademark prohibition is stated

text: complete BSD-Systemics-W3Works grant, conditions, no-relicensing sentence, and disclaimers contain no express patent grant, patent condition, patent-claim restriction, or patent-termination clause

text: source/binary redistribution conditions require copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer; Systemics attribution is required in a product, and separate Systemics and W3Works acknowledgements are required for advertising materials, creating a material multi-surface notice burden
